verdict.rationale: A business-operations SaaS like Firstbase could plausibly offer user-defined automation rules, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only vendor-run automation: compliance deadline tracking with filings made on the user's behalf, continuous book reconciliation, and automated sales-tax filings. None of it describes users defining their own event-triggered rules, and a bare 'Advanced API integrations' pricing line is not a rule engine.
